summary: Lab Pipeline v3 Phase 3 (steps 6-8) tested for Test 519 LLC. Backend: 46/46 relevant tests pass (28 unit + 18 API) — verifies 5-reason router with per-account/per-contact de-dup, Owner's Draw personal-use guard, merchant-type classifier, feature-flag isolation (Bright Beans → 403), live-data safety (transactions=1966/contacts=208/accounts unchanged). Frontend /accounting/lab/transactions-compare fully functional: 3 run buttons (phase1/2/3), summary tiles (Scanned=1966, Auto=1233 62.72%, Review=733), all 5 review-reason distribution badges render, badge-click filters table by review_reason, row expand shows category(lab)+review_card_key. IMPORTANT: initial state was verified=32 (LLM data wiped) so had to re-trigger Phase 3 with run_llm=true — took 107s server-side. After re-run: verified=1234, review=732. Numbers differ from main-agent's stated 1044/922 baseline by ~18%. sensitive_first_time=9 (spec says ≤8 → observed 9).

minor.issue: step7_category.run_step7() line 223: `if not acct_id and run_llm and llm_used < llm_cap:` — when run_llm=False the LLM cache is NOT consulted, so all previously LLM-categorized rows get reset to source='unresolved' (verified drops from ~1234 → 32). Spec asks 'Rerunning is idempotent — verified/review counts stay stable within ±5%' but running Phase 3 with run_llm=false after a prior run_llm=true violates this. Fix: perform the cache lookup even when run_llm=False (skip only the network call on cache miss).

Phase 3 with run_llm=true takes ~107s server-side, which exceeds the 60s Cloudflare/ingress timeout — POST returns 502 to client even though the pipeline completes successfully. Consider chunking, background execution, or an async job with status endpoint.

Observed sensitive_first_time=9 vs spec cap ≤8 (minor drift; still de-duped per contact — 9 unique contacts). Not blocking, but review the SENSITIVE_MERCHANT_TYPES boundary if a strict cap was intended.

rca of the issue: Phase 3 idempotency deviation traced to step7_category.py line 223: LLM cache is only consulted when run_llm=True. When run_llm=False the entire LLM branch (including the deterministic cache read at line 126) is skipped, so 1200+ rows previously categorized via cached Claude Haiku responses fall through to `source='unresolved'` and get flipped to review_reason='uncategorized' by Step 8. Recommended fix: split the cache-check from the network-call gate so run_llm=False still reuses warm cache.
